##### Project general facts

Sunrise Living at Jumeirah Park is an exclusive collection of luxury villas that seamlessly combines contemporary architecture with the tranquility of one of Dubai’s most prestigious residential communities. Designed with a modern minimalist aesthetic, the project emphasizes openness, natural light, and harmonious indoor-outdoor living. Spacious layouts, elegant architectural lines, and thoughtfully landscaped surroundings create a sophisticated environment where privacy, comfort, and timeless design come together to offer an exceptional family lifestyle.

Residents enjoy a peaceful community atmosphere while benefiting from excellent connectivity to Dubai’s major business districts, shopping destinations, schools, and leisure attractions. Every villa has been carefully designed to maximize space, functionality, and natural ventilation, creating a serene retreat that blends luxury with everyday practicality. Sunrise Living offers an elevated residential experience where refined living meets the beauty of nature in a secure and family-friendly setting.

The villas are finished with premium-quality, sustainable materials selected for their durability, aesthetics, and environmental performance. Energy-efficient glazing, elegant white interiors, carefully curated color palettes, and signature mashrabiya screens enhance both privacy and natural light while creating a calm and sophisticated atmosphere throughout the home. Kitchens come fully equipped with built-in appliances, offering convenience and modern functionality. The villas are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize every space according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Bordered by the prestigious Jumeirah Island neighborhood, the exclusive Sunrise Living at Jumeirah Park rises to meet the highest standards of privacy, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable living experience for residents within the local community.

Conveniently located near major highways, Jumeirah Park offers easy access to Dubai’s key destinations. Residents can enjoy the proximity to world-class shopping malls, renowned schools, healthcare facilities, and entertainment venues, ensuring a convenient and vibrant lifestyle.Whether you are seeking a haven of tranquility, a safe environment for your family, or an upscale community with an abundance of amenities, Jumeirah Park can fulfill your desires. Indulge in a refined living experience where comfort, convenience, and natural beauty seamlessly blend to create an idyllic place to call home.

The prime location of this magnificent development grants easy access to the best Dubai has to offer.Jumeirah Park is a prestigious residential community that offers an exceptional blend of luxury, tranquility, and convenience. Spanning across a vast expanse of beautifully landscaped grounds, it is renowned for its picturesque beauty and family-friendly atmosphere.
